title: Assert on NULL user_data in netcode_generate_connect_token()
body: Just a minor issue I ran into: `netcode_generate_connect_token()` and `netcode_generate_connect_token_private()` assert on `user_data`, but the latter checks for a null pointer, so the asserts can possibly be removed.

nodes.body: Got it. Throw me a pull request and I'm happy to consider this change!
